title: Handling the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts

entities.name: Bearer resource request procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests allocation of additional bearer resources from the network.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept a bearer resource request when maximum active EPS bearer contexts is reached.

entities.name: Maximum active EPS bearer contexts reached at network
entities.description: Condition where network has reached its maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Maximum active EPS bearer contexts reached at UE
entities.description: Condition where UE has reached its maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: GBR requirement in request
entities.description: Condition where UE request includes a Guaranteed Bit Rate requirement.

entities.name: Network rejects bearer resource request
entities.description: Network behavior to reject UE request for additional bearer resources when maximum is reached.

entities.name: Network accepts bearer resource request
entities.description: Network behavior to accept UE request by sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: UE deactivates EPS bearer context
entities.description: UE behavior to deactivate an active EPS bearer context when maximum is reached.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context for emergency
entities.description: Condition identifying a default EPS bearer context used for emergency services.

relations.description: Bearer resource request procedure is guarded by condition of maximum active EPS bearer contexts reached at network.
Maximum bearers condition at network establishes rejection behavior when GBR requirement exists.
Maximum bearers condition at network establishes acceptance behavior via MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
Acceptance behavior triggers sending of MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
GBR requirement condition guards the rejection behavior when maximum bearers reached.
Maximum bearers condition at UE establishes deactivation behavior prior to sending request.
Emergency default bearer condition guards deactivation behavior - UE shall not deactivate emergency default bearer.
